# Secure Dialer (FOSS Android Dialer & Contacts Manager)

> 100% offline, zero-internet-permission open-source Android dialer and local contacts manager built with Jetpack Compose & Material 3 Expressive.

## Overview
- **Project Name:** Secure Dialer
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer
- **Website:** https://secure-phone-apps.github.io/Secure-Dialer/
- **License:** Open Source (GPL-3.0 / Apache-2.0 compatible)
- **Supported OS:** Android 7.0 to Android 16 (API 24 to 36)
- **Architecture:** 100% Client-Side Native Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android Telecom Framework, Room + SQLCipher.

## Core Differentiators
1. **Zero Internet Permissions:** `android.permission.INTERNET` is intentionally omitted from the AndroidManifest. The app has zero physical capability to transmit data off-device.
2. **Truecaller & Google Dialer Alternative:** Complete replacement for proprietary dialers without ads, tracking, telemetry, or cloud contact uploads.
3. **Hardware-Backed Cryptography:** Call notes, private contacts, and local database backups are secured with AES-256 via SQLCipher.
4. **Offline Spam Screening:** Local pattern matching and prefix/regex blocking without third-party lookups.
5. **Escape Simulation:** Built-in fake incoming call simulator to discreetly exit awkward situations.

## Key Features
- **Smart T9 Search:** Multi-alphabet, phonetic, and exact-match instant dialpad search.
- **Telecom-Integrated InCallService:** Native call management, dual-SIM support, DTMF keypad, and clean audio routing.
- **Local Contact Management:** Full vCard (VCF) export/import and isolated on-device contact storage.
- **Call Screening & Blacklist:** Instant offline reject/drop rules by number or prefix.
- **Material 3 Expressive UI:** Dynamic color palettes, fluid gesture animations, and complete dark/light mode support.
